topic_ko: 식물의 생존 전략인 씨앗 — 잭프루트는 달콤한 향과 과육으로 동물을 유인해 씨앗을 퍼뜨림

passage: Plants are truly remarkable living things.
Over their long history, they have worked out many different ways to stay alive.
Among these, seeds stand out as one of the most powerful tools they have ever built.
To move their seeds to new ground, plants will try almost anything.
They hand out tasty food to animals as payment for carrying those seeds away.
Jackfruit, the biggest fruit that grows on a tree, gives off a sweet smell like that of pineapples and bananas.
That smell pulls animals in, and while they enjoy the soft flesh they swallow the seeds as well.
The flesh is broken down inside the animal, but the seeds come out whole and sprout where they fall.
choices: how plants trade tasty fruit for the transport of their seeds
why tropical fruits smell sweeter than fruits of cold regions
how animals learn which fruits in a forest are safe to eat
the process by which an animal's stomach breaks down plant matter
the reason jackfruit grows larger than any other tree fruit
theme.explanation_ko: 식물이 맛있는 과육을 내주고 그 대가로 동물이 씨앗을 옮겨 준다는 거래가 글 전체를 관통하는 내용이므로 ①이 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ② 열대 과일의 향을 다른 지역과 비교한 내용은 없다. ③ 동물이 안전한 열매를 배우는 과정은 다루지 않는다. ④ 소화 과정은 씨앗이 소화되지 않는다는 점을 설명하기 위한 세부일 뿐이다. ⑤ 잭프루트가 가장 크다는 것은 부수적 정보이다.

passage: Plants are amazing in ways we rarely notice.
Throughout the long time they have existed, they have built up many survival strategies.
Seeds, above all, are among the strongest of those strategies.
A plant will go to any length to send its seeds somewhere new.
The usual method is simple: give animals a meal, and let the animals do the moving.
Jackfruit, the largest fruit borne by any tree, smells sweet enough to draw animals from far away.
Tempted by the flesh, the animals swallow the seeds along with it.
The seeds survive the journey through the body and grow where the animals leave them.
choices: 식물은 동물에게 먹이를 주고 그 대가로 씨앗을 퍼뜨리게 한다.
동물은 먹이를 고를 때 냄새보다 크기를 더 중요하게 여긴다.
씨앗이 소화되지 않는 것은 식물에게 오히려 손해가 된다.
잭프루트는 크기 때문에 동물이 옮기기 어려운 열매이다.
식물의 생존 전략은 대부분 동물을 쫓아내는 방향으로 발달했다.
gist.explanation_ko: 먹이를 제공하고 그 보답으로 씨앗을 옮기게 하는 상호 이익의 거래가 요지이므로 ①이 적절하다.
gist.distractor_ko: ② 냄새와 크기를 비교한 서술은 없다. ③ 씨앗이 소화되지 않는 것은 식물에게 이득이다. ④ 동물이 옮기기 어렵다는 내용은 본문과 반대이다. ⑤ 동물을 유인하는 전략이므로 정반대이다.

passage: Plants have spent their whole existence inventing ways to survive.
Of all those inventions, the seed may be the cleverest.
A plant cannot walk, so it pays others to walk for it.
The fee it offers is a meal of sweet, soft fruit.
Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, advertises itself with a smell close to pineapple and banana.
Animals come for the flesh and end up swallowing the seeds too.
Their bodies digest the flesh but leave the seeds untouched.
Dropped far from the parent tree, those seeds sprout, and the jackfruit spreads.
choices: A Sweet Meal in Exchange for a Free Ride
Why Big Fruits Are Hard for Animals to Eat
The Long Battle Between Plants and Animals
How Farmers Grow the World's Largest Fruit
Digestion: The Journey Food Takes Inside Us
title.explanation_ko: 달콤한 한 끼를 주고 씨앗 운반이라는 이동 수단을 얻는 거래를 담아야 하므로 ①이 제목으로 가장 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ② 먹기 어렵다는 내용이 아니다. ③ 식물과 동물은 싸우는 것이 아니라 협력한다. ④ 재배 방법은 다루지 않는다. ⑤ 소화는 씨앗이 살아남는 과정을 보이기 위한 배경일 뿐이다.

passage: Plants have created diverse survival strategies during their long existence.
Seeds are among the most powerful of them, and moving those seeds is the plant's greatest problem.
Plants will do anything to spread their seeds.
A plant cannot move, so it pays for a ride.
Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, gives off a sweet smell that draws animals near.
It tempts them with soft flesh so that the seeds go down with the meal.
The flesh is digested, but the seeds pass through the animal untouched.
Where the animals leave them, the seeds sprout and a new jackfruit tree begins.
choices: it gives animals food so that they will carry its seeds
it charges animals a price for entering its territory
it grows taller so that the wind can lift its seeds
it saves its energy until the rainy season arrives
it lets its fruit fall and roll down the hillside
implication.explanation_ko: 움직일 수 없는 식물이 '이동 삯을 치른다'는 것은 먹이를 대가로 내주고 동물이 씨앗을 옮겨 주게 한다는 뜻이므로 ①이 적절하다.
implication.distractor_ko: ② 영역 출입에 대한 값이라는 내용은 없다. ③ 바람에 의한 확산은 본문에 등장하지 않는다. ④ 우기까지 에너지를 아낀다는 서술은 없다. ⑤ 열매가 굴러 퍼진다는 방식은 언급되지 않았다.

passage: Plants are amazing, and throughout their long existence they have created diverse survival strategies.
Seeds, in particular, are one of the strongest techniques which they have developed.
Plants will do anything to spread their seeds, since they cannot move on their own.
They offer tasty food to animals in return for distributing their seeds.
Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, have a sweet smell that attracts animals from far away.
It tempts animals to eat its delicious flesh, thereby getting them to swallow the seeds as well.
The flesh is digested by the animals that consume it, but the seeds are not.
When the animals drop the seeds, the seeds begin to sprout and grow.
choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤
grammar.explanation_ko: 주어는 단수 Jackfruit 이고 the world's largest tree fruit 는 동격 삽입구일 뿐이므로 have 가 아니라 has 여야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 긴 존속 기간과 어울리는 현재완료로 적절하다. ② developed 의 목적어가 빠진 목적격 관계대명사절이라 옳다. ③ for 가 전치사이므로 동명사 distributing 이 맞다. ⑤ thereby 뒤의 분사구문이며 get 은 목적격보어로 to부정사를 취하므로 옳다.

passage: Throughout their long existence, plants have developed diverse survival strategies.
Seeds are one of the strongest techniques among them.
Plants will do anything to spread their seeds to new ground.
They offer tasty food to animals in return for distributing those seeds.
Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, has a sweet smell that repels animals, much like pineapples and bananas.
It tempts them to eat its delicious flesh, thereby getting them to swallow the seeds too.
The flesh is digested by the animals, but the seeds pass through their digestive tracts untouched.
When the animals poop out the seeds, the seeds sprout and the jackfruit spreads.
choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤
vocab.explanation_ko: 달콤한 냄새는 동물을 불러들여 과육을 먹게 만드는 장치이므로 repels(쫓아낸다)가 아니라 attracts(끌어당긴다)가 되어야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ① 여러 가지 생존 전략이라는 뜻으로 자연스럽다. ② 씨앗을 퍼뜨려 주는 '대가로'라는 의미로 옳다. ④ 과육으로 '유혹한다'는 흐름에 맞는다. ⑤ 씨앗이 소화되지 않고 '그대로' 통과한다는 의미로 적절하다.

passage: Plants have spent their long existence building survival strategies, and seeds are the strongest of them.
The trouble is that a plant cannot walk its seeds to a new place.
So it hires help, and it pays with food.
Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, releases a sweet smell much like that of pineapples and bananas.
Animals follow the smell and eat the soft flesh, swallowing the seeds along with it.
Their bodies digest the flesh, yet the seeds move through the digestive tract untouched.
Dropped far away in the animals' waste, the seeds sprout and a new tree begins to grow.
In short, the fruit is the price a plant pays to ______________________.
choices: have animals carry its seeds far from the parent tree
keep hungry animals away from its youngest branches
store enough water to survive a long dry season
make its seeds hard enough to resist strong winds
grow larger leaves that capture more sunlight
blank.explanation_ko: 과육이라는 '값'을 치르고 얻는 것은 동물이 씨앗을 멀리 옮겨 주는 일이므로 ①이 빈칸에 적절하다.
blank.distractor_ko: ② 동물을 쫓아내는 것은 글의 취지와 반대이다. ③ 물 저장은 언급되지 않았다. ④ 바람에 견디는 씨앗 이야기는 없다. ⑤ 잎과 광합성은 이 글의 화제가 아니다.

irrelevant.intro: Throughout their long existence, plants have created diverse survival strategies, and seeds are one of the strongest.
sentences: Because a plant cannot move, it must persuade something else to carry its seeds away.
It offers tasty food to animals in return for distributing those seeds.
Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, gives off a sweet smell that attracts animals.
Most fruit trees in cold climates need several weeks of low temperature before they will flower.
Tempted by the flesh, animals swallow the seeds, which pass through their bodies untouched.
choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤
irrelevant.explanation_ko: ④는 추운 기후 과수의 개화 조건에 관한 진술로, 먹이를 주고 씨앗을 퍼뜨린다는 흐름에서 벗어난다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②는 거래의 원리를 제시하고, ③⑤는 잭프루트라는 구체적 사례로 그 원리를 뒷받침하므로 모두 흐름에 맞는다.

order.given: Plants are amazing. Throughout their long existence they have created diverse survival strategies, and seeds are one of the strongest techniques they have developed.

blocks.A: Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, has a sweet smell that attracts animals, similar to pineapples and bananas. It tempts them to eat its delicious flesh, and in doing so it gets them to swallow the seeds as well.
blocks.B: The problem, however, is that a plant cannot walk. So it will do anything to spread its seeds, even offering tasty food to animals in return for distributing them.
blocks.C: The flesh is digested, but the seeds are not, and they pass through the animals' digestive tracts untouched. When the animals poop them out, the seeds sprout, and in exchange for a satisfying meal the animals have spread the jackfruit.

order.explanation_ko: 생존 전략으로서의 씨앗(주어진 글) → 움직일 수 없다는 문제와 먹이 거래라는 원리(B) → 잭프루트라는 사례(A) → 소화되지 않은 씨앗의 확산이라는 결과(C) 순이 자연스럽다.
order.distractor_ko: (B)의 'The problem, however' 는 주어진 글의 씨앗 소개를 받아야 하고, (A)의 잭프루트는 (B)가 말한 '먹이 거래'의 구체적 예이며, (C)의 'The flesh' 는 (A)에 나온 과육을 가리키므로 마지막이어야 한다.

insert.insert_sentence: The flesh is digested by the animals that consume it, but the seeds are not digested at all.

passage_marked.text: Throughout their long existence, plants have created diverse survival strategies, and seeds are one of the strongest.
Because plants cannot move, they offer tasty food to animals in return for distributing their seeds.
Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, has a sweet smell that attracts animals and tempts them to eat its flesh.
Instead, they pass through the animals' digestive tracts untouched.
When these animals poop out the seeds, the seeds sprout and grow, and the jackfruit spreads.

choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤
insert.explanation_ko: 과육과 씨앗의 운명을 대비하는 문장은 동물이 과육을 먹는 장면 뒤(③)에 와야 하며, 바로 뒤 문장의 Instead, they 가 소화되지 않는 씨앗을 받는다.
insert.distractor_ko: ①② 자리는 아직 동물이 과육을 먹는 장면이 나오지 않아 the flesh 가 가리킬 대상이 없다. ④⑤ 뒤에 넣으면 Instead, they 가 앞선 부정을 받지 못해 문맥이 끊긴다.

passage: Plants have built up many survival strategies over their long existence, and seeds are the strongest of them.
Yet a plant cannot carry its own seeds anywhere.
So it offers animals a meal and lets them do the carrying.
Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, gives off a sweet smell that draws animals near.
Tempted by the soft flesh, the animals swallow the seeds along with their food.
The flesh is digested, but the seeds move through the digestive tract untouched.
When the animals poop out the seeds, the seeds sprout and grow into new trees.
Both sides gain: the animals get a satisfying meal, and the jackfruit gets new ground.
summary.summary_template: Jackfruit uses its sweet smell and tasty flesh to __(A)__ animals, and because its seeds are never digested, the animals end up __(B)__ them to new places.
summary.explanation_ko: 달콤한 향과 과육은 동물을 '유인(lure)'하는 수단이고, 소화되지 않은 씨앗은 동물에 의해 새로운 곳으로 '운반(carrying)'되므로 lure–carrying 이 적절하다.
summary.distractor_ko: warn(경고하다)·avoid(피하다)는 동물을 끌어들인다는 내용과 반대이고, destroying(파괴하다)은 씨앗이 손상되지 않는다는 사실과 어긋나며, storing(저장하다)은 본문에 없는 행동이다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 식물은 씨앗을 퍼뜨려 주는 대가로 동물에게 맛있는 먹이를 제공한다.
writing.answer: Plants offer tasty food to animals in return for distributing their seeds.
writing.explanation_ko: offer A to B(‘B에게 A를 제공하다’) 구조이며, in return for 의 for 는 전치사이므로 뒤에 동명사 distributing 이 온다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 잭프루트는 동물을 끌어당기는 달콤한 냄새를 지니고 있다.
conditions: 주격 관계대명사 that 을 사용할 것
attract 를 알맞은 형태로 사용할 것
writing.answer: Jackfruit has a sweet smell that attracts animals.
writing.explanation_ko: 선행사 a sweet smell 이 단수이므로 관계사절의 동사도 attracts 로 단수 일치시킨다.

writing.question: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오.
writing.context: The fruit flesh is digested by the animals, but the seeds are not ___________ and pass through the animals' digestive tracts untouched.
writing.explanation_ko: 과육은 소화되지만 씨앗은 소화되지 않는다는 대비이므로 앞 절의 digested 를 그대로 받아 쓴다.

writing.question: 다음 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: It tempts animals to eat delicious fruit flesh, thereby getting them to eat the seeds.
writing.answer: 잭프루트는 동물이 맛있는 과육을 먹도록 유혹하고, 그렇게 함으로써 동물이 씨앗까지 먹게 만든다.
writing.explanation_ko: tempt + 목적어 + to부정사(‘…가 ~하도록 유혹하다’) 구조이며, thereby getting 이하는 결과를 나타내는 분사구문이다.

writing.question: 본문을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Jackfruit's sweet smell __(A)__ animals, and in exchange for a satisfying meal the animals __(B)__ the jackfruit seeds.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문에서 달콤한 냄새는 동물을 attracts 하고, 마지막 문장에서 동물은 씨앗을 spread 한다고 서술되어 있다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 이 글의 주제문을 영어로 쓰시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이 글의 주제를 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
conditions: food 와 seeds 를 반드시 포함할 것
writing.answer: Plants such as jackfruit give animals tasty food so that the animals spread their seeds.
writing.explanation_ko: 맛있는 먹이를 제공하고 그 대가로 씨앗을 퍼뜨리게 한다는 상호 이익의 거래를 한 문장에 담으면 된다.
